comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten a pin-index oxygen regulator to a cylinder valve; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a yoke over a valve, mate keyed pins and washer, then tighten a T-handle versus support a long rail, engage spring prongs at two posts, telescope, and drive screws.
comparison.success_condition: Requires keyed seating, seal alignment, minimum hand torque, cylinder safety, stillness, and release; candidate requires correct rail side, rack-unit match, spring extension, bottom screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both install hardware and tighten it, but the regulator tests keyed sealing and torque on one interface, not distributed structural latching.
